transmissions.broadcast_format: Continuous mechanical escapement chime + synthetic female voice reciting 5-digit phonetic groups
transmissions.signal_anomaly: Signal strength increases during severe geomagnetic storms and drops during clear daylight
transmissions.transcript: [RHYTHMIC CLOCKWORK ESCAPEMENT: 24 TICKS/MIN] ... 'ULYANA ... DMITRI ... 4 - 8 - 1 - 0 - 9 ... 4 - 8 - 1 - 0 - 9 ... THE CRADLE IS EMPTY IN THE WEST ... 7 - 0 - 0 - 2 - 1 ... [DOUBLE BELL CHIME] ... STAND BY FOR CARRIER.'
transmissions.cipher_clue: Numbers match the coordinates of the sealed fertilizer depot at Lock 6.

transmissions.broadcast_format: Sub-audible 32Hz organ pedal drone interrupted by 3-tone flute arpeggios
transmissions.signal_anomaly: Frequency modulates with underwater acoustic tides in the flooded basin
transmissions.transcript: [LOW 32Hz SUB-BASS ORGAN HUM] ... [THREE WOOD FLUTE NOTES: A-FLAT, C, E] ... 'SEVEN HUNDRED FATHOMS OF COLD SILT ... DO NOT DIG BENEATH THE SANCTUARY FLOOR ... WE ARE COUNTING THE RINGS ON THE BELL ... 0 - 0 - 9 - 4 - 2 ...'
transmissions.cipher_clue: Relates to the bronze sanctuary bell unrecovered during the Lock 4 evacuation.

transmissions.broadcast_format: Endless magnetic wire loop playing a telephone operator's test greeting recorded in 1968
transmissions.signal_anomaly: Background audio contains the sound of a woman crying and turning blueprint pages
transmissions.transcript: [SCRATCHY WIRE HISS] ... 'This is District Relay 12 test loop. All twelve lines to the capital are occupied. Please hold the wire. The operator will reconnect when the switchboard cools down... [PAGES RUSTLING] ... He took the key with him, mama... [FAINT SOBBING] ... This is District Relay 12 test loop...'
transmissions.cipher_clue: Points to the location of the master telegraph cable under the Glacier pass.

transmissions.broadcast_format: Very Low Frequency (VLF) rhythmic thumping matching geophone pulses at 40 bpm
transmissions.estimated_origin: Deep Crustal Fault -120m below Silent Foundry
transmissions.signal_anomaly: Acoustic vibration travels through bedrock and can be heard by putting an ear against bunker water pipes
transmissions.transcript: [HEAVY DULL IMPACT: THUMP ... THUMP ... THUMP (40 BPM)] ... [SYNTHETIC VOCODER WHISPER]: 'STRATA 4 SHIFTING ... SEVEN CENTIMETERS TOWARD THE RIVER ... THE ANVIL CANNOT HOLD THE BEDROCK ... REINFORCE SECTOR B BEFORE THE RUNOFF ...'
transmissions.cipher_clue: Predicts structural stress points in the bunker's lower foundation walls.

transmissions.broadcast_format: Automated aviation emergency beacon transmitting broken Morse code every 90 seconds
transmissions.estimated_origin: Crashed Cargo Transport on North Ridge
transmissions.signal_anomaly: Carrier fades into harmonic whistling when wind speeds exceed 60 km/h
transmissions.transcript: [MORSE AUDIO BEAT]: ... --- ... / -... --- -..- / .---- -...- ....- / -.. . .- -.. // (SOS / BOX 1-4 / DEAD) ... [VOICE SQUAWK]: 'Altitude zero. Cargo uncompromised. Sixty drums of winter turbine lubricant intact. Do not send searchers until spring melt.'
transmissions.cipher_clue: Exact coordinates for the North Ridge aircraft wreckage and its lubricant cache.

transmissions.broadcast_format: A small child reciting multiplication tables in Russian, interrupted by a metronome
transmissions.signal_anomaly: Broadcast triggers exclusively at 02:15 AM local time for exactly seven minutes
transmissions.transcript: [METRONOME: 72 BPM] ... 'Six times seven is forty-two. Six times eight is forty-eight. The air filter smells like burnt honey. Seven times seven is forty-nine... We turned off the red lamp because it got too hot... Seven times eight is fifty-six...'
transmissions.cipher_clue: Burnt honey is the distinct smell of overheating potassium superoxide canisters.

transmissions.broadcast_format: Digital telemetry packet followed by synthesized barometric pressure readings
transmissions.estimated_origin: Offshore Weather Mast on the Ash-Sea
transmissions.signal_anomaly: Transmits water acidity pH values that correlate with toxic storm severity
transmissions.transcript: [FSK DATA BURST: 1200 BAUD] ... 'BUOY NINE ALPHA. SURFACE WATER TEMPERATURE: MINUS THREE POINT TWO. ACIDITY: PH 3.1 (EXTREME SULFURIC RUNOFF). GAMMA BACKGROUND AT SURFACE: 1.4 MILLISIEVERTS PER HOUR. VESSEL TRAFFIC: ZERO. THE SEA IS EMPTY.'
transmissions.cipher_clue: Provides real-time warning before high-acidity squalls reach the harbor.

transmissions.broadcast_format: Phased array sweep radar whine modulated with faint human radio chatter
transmissions.signal_anomaly: Echo reflects off the ionized boundary layer created by high-altitude fallout
transmissions.transcript: [ROTATING RADAR CHIRP: 3.5s SWEEP] ... 'Target track 901 lost over the sea... [STATIC BURST] ... No return from Sector 4... Is that rain on the radome or lead shot? ... [SWEEP CHIRP] ... Track confirmed zero... The sweep is clean...'
transmissions.cipher_clue: Points to the high-frequency radar receiver components needed to repair the bunker's storm scanner.

transmissions.broadcast_format: Continuous 50Hz electrical transformer hum overlaid with intermittent telegraph clicks
transmissions.signal_anomaly: Fires only when the 4,000V dead-hand system encounters ground leakage
transmissions.transcript: [HEAVY 50Hz MAINS HUM] ... [TELEGRAPH TICKING]: '-.-. --- -.. . / ----. ----. / -.. . -... -' (CODE 99 DEBT) ... [SYNTHESIZED CLOCK VOICE]: 'RECONCILIATION COUNTER: INCREMENTED. THE CHARTER IS RECORDED IN MERCURY.'
transmissions.cipher_clue: Direct link to the reconciliation debt counter in exp_08 and exp_12.

transmissions.broadcast_format: Acoustic ultrasonic through-water voice communication transceiver
transmissions.estimated_origin: Sunken Submarine Trench in Tessarat Fjord
transmissions.signal_anomaly: Can only be received using underwater hydrophone probes hooked to radio antenna
transmissions.transcript: [ULTRASONIC HYDROPHONE BUBBLES] ... 'Tether four is caught on the propeller shaft... [GASP OF OXYGEN] ... The lead door on Hold Three is locked from the inside... There is no water inside Hold Three... I repeat, Hold Three is completely dry...'
transmissions.cipher_clue: Reveals the secret airtight survival pocket inside the sunken hull.

transmissions.broadcast_format: High-frequency FM carrier with decaying sinusoidal telemetry tone
transmissions.signal_anomaly: Frequency exhibits severe Doppler shift as satellite orbits overhead (+/- 12 kHz)
transmissions.transcript: [DOPPLER WHINE: DESCENDING PITCH] ... [HIGH SPEED TELEMETRY BEEPING] ... 'CORE TEMPERATURE: 840 KELVIN ... HEAT SHIELD INTEGRITY: TWELVE PERCENT ... IMPACT VECTOR CALCULATED: SECTOR NINE TESSARAT ... TUNGSTEN PAYLOAD LOCKED ...'
transmissions.cipher_clue: Enables early calculation of kinetic impact coordinates for exp_11 sky armor preparation.

transmissions.broadcast_format: Warped brass band playing a slow pre-war national anthem through extreme wow and flutter
transmissions.estimated_origin: Automated Civil Defense Tower in the Ruined Capital
transmissions.signal_anomaly: Audio slows down by 2% each year as the backup battery voltage drains towards absolute zero
transmissions.transcript: [SLOW, DISTORTED BRASS BAND: DRAGGING TEMPO] ... [METALLIC SCRATCH OF TURNTABLE NEEDLE] ... [FAINT DISTANT CHEERING FROM A 1970 PARADE RECORDING] ... [SUDDEN CARRIER DROP TO COMPLETE SILENCE FOR 60 SECONDS] ... [REPEATS]
transmissions.cipher_clue: Symbol of the dead world whose memory slowly runs down in the frost.
